title: Assistant agentic domain and config foundation

criteria.statement: Domain package defines provider-neutral agent loop state, tool observation, deferred action, message, and tool-call skeleton types without implementing the loop/runtime/model clients.
Assistant permission mode, decision, effect, risk, and execution-mode types have a single owner in internal/domain/assistant_permissions.go.

Assistant transcript kind 30316 constants and content structs represent bahia.assistant-transcript.v1 as a service-held symmetric-key AEAD envelope with key-reference and rotation metadata mirrored in tags.
AssistantApprovalRequest accepts additive action_id and cancel_scope fields while preserving plan_hash JSON compatibility.
AssistantConfig exposes agentic, permissions, and mcp.async_observation blocks with validation; legacy assistant LLM config remains valid when agentic is disabled.
